attractions.name: Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts
attractions.kidNote: Likely a top-3 ride for the kids; Bellatrix, Voldemort and the dragon fire can rattle a sensitive rider.
attractions.tip: USF closes at 5 PM on HHN dates, so ride it first at 9 AM; single rider is the fastest backup.

attractions.name: Hogwarts Express – King's Cross Station
attractions.kidNote: Walking through the Platform 9¾ wall is a jaw-drop moment for the kids.
attractions.tip: You need a park-to-park ticket. Each direction shows a different story, so ride both ways.

attractions.name: Ollivanders Experience in Diagon Alley
attractions.kidNote: Each show picks one guest for a wand; it's huge if your kid is chosen.
attractions.tip: Go in the first hour. Interactive wands work on spell spots all over Diagon Alley.

attractions.name: Celestina Warbeck and the Banshees
attractions.kidNote: Jazzy wizard concert; the twins will like it more than the youngest.
attractions.tip: Use it as a rest stop in Carkitt Market; it alternates on the same stage with Beedle the Bard.

attractions.name: The Tales of Beedle the Bard
attractions.kidNote: Short puppet show of the Three Brothers tale; charming, and it ends before anyone gets bored.
attractions.tip: Catch it right before or after Celestina so the two shows run back to back.

attractions.name: The Knight Bus
attractions.kidNote: The wisecracking shrunken head gets big laughs.
attractions.tip: It's a walk-up photo op on the London waterfront; check the app for when the conductor is out.

attractions.name: Death Eaters in Knockturn Alley
attractions.kidNote: Masked Death Eaters lurk in the dark alley and may stare down the youngest; the twins will think it's cool.
attractions.tip: Seasonal, Aug 27–Nov 1. Borgin and Burkes is open too.

attractions.name: Revenge of the Mummy
attractions.kidNote: The twins will love the launches; darkness, fire, scarabs and mummies may be too much for the youngest.
attractions.tip: Use single rider or Child Swap. Lockers are required.

alternatives.name: Race Through New York Starring Jimmy Fallon

alternatives.name: Ollivanders Experience in Diagon Alley

alternatives.name: The Tales of Beedle the Bard
alternatives.why: Short seated puppet show in Carkitt Market that fits the length of a Mummy wait

attractions.name: Race Through New York Starring Jimmy Fallon
attractions.kidNote: Silly theater-style race; fun once but not memorable.
attractions.tip: The queue gives you a numbered ticket and you wait in a lounge, so the real wait is short.

attractions.name: The Blues Brothers Show
attractions.kidNote: Kids will likely be bored.
attractions.tip: Low priority on a short 9–5 day.

attractions.name: ¡Vamos! – Báilalo
attractions.kidNote: High-energy Latin dance show; works as a quick stop.
attractions.tip: Check the app for times. Treat it as filler.

attractions.name: Marilyn & the Diamond Bellas
attractions.kidNote: Aimed at adults; kids will shrug.
attractions.tip: Skip unless you happen to be passing by.

attractions.name: Beat Builders
attractions.kidNote: Percussion on buckets and tools; loud fun for kids.
attractions.tip: Catch it as you walk between New York and Diagon Alley.

attractions.name: MEN IN BLACK Alien Attack
attractions.kidNote: Laser-blaster scoring game with spins; kids love beating Dad's score.
attractions.tip: Single rider moves fast. Lockers are required.

attractions.name: The Simpsons Ride
attractions.kidNote: Goofy cartoon chaos, but the dome simulator is rough on queasy kids.
attractions.tip: Ride it before lunch, and skip it if anyone gets motion sick.

attractions.name: Kang & Kodos' Twirl 'n' Hurl
attractions.kidNote: Dumbo-style spinner; fine for the youngest, the twins may find it babyish.
attractions.tip: Only ride if the wait is 10 minutes or less.

attractions.name: The Simpsons Character Meet & Greet
attractions.kidNote: Quick photo with Homer or Bart.
attractions.tip: Check the app for character times.

attractions.name: TRANSFORMERS: The Ride-3D
attractions.kidNote: The twins will love the loud 3-D robot battles; the youngest may find the noise and drops intense.
attractions.tip: Single rider is often a walk-on.

attractions.name: Transformers Meet & Greet (Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, Megatron)
attractions.kidNote: Megatron trash-talks you, and kids love it.
attractions.tip: Look outside the ride exit.

attractions.name: SpongeBob & Friends Meet & Greet
attractions.kidNote: Quick photo op.
attractions.tip: Check the app for times and location.

attractions.name: Despicable Me Minion Mayhem
attractions.kidNote: Kids become Minions, and there's a dance party at the end; the simulator bounces more than you'd expect.
attractions.tip: Ride in the first or last hour, and ask a Team Member about stationary seating for anyone motion sensitive.

attractions.name: Illumination's Villain-Con Minion Blast
attractions.kidNote: Video-game blaster on a moving walkway; kids get competitive about scores.
attractions.tip: Link the ride to the Universal app to save and compare scores.

attractions.name: Illumination Theater (Minions, Gru & the Girls Meet)
attractions.kidNote: Hugs with Minions and Gru; the youngest will be the bigger fan.
attractions.tip: Check the app for times; lines are usually shorter after 3 PM.

attractions.name: E.T. Adventure
attractions.kidNote: Gentle bike flight; E.T. saying your name at the end is the payoff.
attractions.tip: Give each kid's name at the check-in so E.T. says it at the end.

attractions.name: Animal Actors on Location!
attractions.kidNote: Dogs, cats and birds doing tricks, with kid volunteers; a sure hit.
attractions.tip: Arrive 10 minutes early. Express gets you priority entry.

attractions.name: The Bourne Stuntacular
attractions.kidNote: The screen-plus-live stunts will amaze the twins; the gunfire is loud.
attractions.tip: Arrive 15 minutes early. It's indoors with AC, so save it for midday heat.

attractions.name: Universal Orlando's Horror Make-Up Show
attractions.kidNote: Closed during your dates.
attractions.tip: Closed for reimagining; reopens Winter 2026.

attractions.name: CineSational: A Symphonic Spectacular
attractions.kidNote: Won't be running; USF closes at 5 PM for HHN.
attractions.tip: Not scheduled for Oct 15–17.

attractions.name: Universal Mega Movie Parade
attractions.kidNote: Seasonal parade; not running in October.
attractions.tip: Ended its summer run Aug 10; TouringPlans lists a Spring 2027 return.

attractions.name: Trolls Trollercoaster
attractions.kidNote: A perfect first coaster for the youngest; the twins will want something bigger.
attractions.tip: The ride is about a minute long, so skip it if the wait is over 20 minutes.

attractions.name: DreamWorks Imagination Celebration
attractions.kidNote: Dance-pop show with Shrek, Po and the Trolls; best for younger kids.
attractions.tip: A shaded sit-down break; Express gets you priority seating.

attractions.name: Po's Kung Fu Training Camp
attractions.kidNote: Climbing, gongs and water cannons; the kids will burn energy here.
attractions.tip: Reopened July 4, 2026. Bring a spare shirt.

attractions.name: Po Live!
attractions.kidNote: Closed during your dates.
attractions.tip: Closed for refurbishment with no reopening date announced.

attractions.name: Poppy's Playground
attractions.kidNote: Toddler-skewed; the youngest may get 10 minutes out of it.
attractions.tip: Fine for a short break; otherwise skip.

attractions.name: Shrek's Swamp for Little Ogres
attractions.kidNote: Slides and climbing; good for the youngest.
attractions.tip: Pair it with the Shrek meet next door.

attractions.name: Mama Luna Feline Fiesta
attractions.kidNote: Quick interactive screen game with cats.
attractions.tip: Takes 5 minutes; do it in passing.

attractions.name: King Harold's Swamp Symphony
attractions.kidNote: Musical lily pads you stomp on.
attractions.tip: Do it in passing.

attractions.name: Shrek, Fiona & Donkey Meet & Greet (Shrek's Swamp)
attractions.kidNote: Shrek stays in character and is funny.
attractions.tip: Check the app for times.

attractions.name: DreamWorks Character Meets (Trolls, Puss in Boots, King Julien, Gabby)
attractions.kidNote: Rotating characters; the Trolls are the youngest's best bet.
attractions.tip: Check the app for the lineup and times.

attractions.name: The Amazing Adventures of Spider-Man
attractions.kidNote: Classic 3-D superhero ride; the villains are loud, but the 400-ft 'drop' is an illusion.
attractions.tip: Single rider is rarely long. Lines dip mid-afternoon.

attractions.name: The Incredible Hulk Coaster
attractions.kidNote: Launch, inversions and speed. 54" minimum: the twins can ride, the youngest can't yet.
attractions.tip: Lockers plus metal detector. Often a walk-on in the first hour or last 30 minutes.

attractions.name: Marvel Character Meet & Greet (Spider-Man, Captain America, X-Men)
attractions.kidNote: Spider-Man poses are a hit.
attractions.tip: Check the app for times.

attractions.name: Dudley Do-Right's Ripsaw Falls
attractions.kidNote: The 75-ft drop gives screams and laughs. Everyone clears the 44" minimum.
attractions.tip: You will be drenched. Ride after 1 PM when it's warm and use the paid dryers.

attractions.name: Popeye & Bluto's Bilge-Rat Barges

attractions.tip: Put phones and shoes in the center bin or a locker. Ponchos barely help.

attractions.name: Me Ship, The Olive

attractions.tip: Good while others ride Ripsaw.

attractions.name: Toon Lagoon Character Meet (Popeye, Olive Oyl, Betty Boop)
attractions.kidNote: Kids likely won't know these characters.
attractions.tip: Low priority.

attractions.name: Skull Island: Reign of Kong
attractions.kidNote: Giant bugs, creepy queue actors and dinosaurs make this one of the scariest rides for the youngest; the Kong finale is currently curtained off.
attractions.tip: Running a modified ride since Sept 18 (Kong animatronic damaged). Single rider line removed Sept 2026.

attractions.name: Jurassic World VelociCoaster
attractions.kidNote: The best coaster in Orlando. The youngest clears the 51" minimum by half an inch; it's the most intense ride here.
attractions.tip: Do it at Early Park Admission or in the last hour. Lockers plus metal detector; Child Swap available.

attractions.tip: No Express and very low capacity: go first thing or skip it.

attractions.name: Camp Jurassic
attractions.kidNote: Huge climbing jungle with caves and water spitters; the kids will love it.
attractions.tip: Ideal while others ride VelociCoaster. Set a meeting spot, because it's easy to lose kids here.

attractions.name: Jurassic Park Discovery Center
attractions.kidNote: Watch a raptor 'hatch', see a full T-rex skeleton, play DNA games.
attractions.tip: Indoor AC break with no line.

attractions.name: Raptor Encounter
attractions.kidNote: A realistic raptor up close; thrilling, and slightly scary if it snaps at you.
attractions.tip: Runs about 10 AM to 6:45 PM with breaks every 20 minutes. Ask the Team Member how long the line is.

attractions.name: Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey

attractions.tip: Walk the castle queue even if you don't ride. Lockers required; Child Swap available.

attractions.tip: Needs a park-to-park ticket; lines are usually shorter on the Hogsmeade side.

attractions.name: Ollivanders
attractions.kidNote: Same wand-choosing show as Diagon Alley.
attractions.tip: Do it in only one park, whichever has the shorter line.

attractions.name: Frog Choir

attractions.tip: Hourly 11 AM–4:30 PM (late-Sept/early-Oct schedule).

attractions.name: Triwizard Spirit Rally

attractions.tip: Hourly 10:30 AM–4 PM (late-Sept/early-Oct schedule).

attractions.name: Dark Arts at Hogwarts Castle
attractions.kidNote: Villain projection show on the castle; Voldemort and Death Eaters may spook the youngest.
attractions.tip: Runs on select nights Sept 5–Nov 1 after dark, before the 8 PM park close. Confirm Oct 15–17 in the app.

attractions.name: The Cat in the Hat
attractions.kidNote: Fast spinning couch through the book; the twins may call it babyish.
attractions.tip: Waits are short all day.

attractions.name: One Fish, Two Fish, Red Fish, Blue Fish
attractions.kidNote: Follow the song's up/down instructions or the squirters get you.
attractions.tip: Skip it if the wait is over 10 minutes.

attractions.name: Caro-Seuss-el
attractions.kidNote: A carousel; the twins may pass.
attractions.tip: Filler only.

attractions.tip: Low capacity: use Express or skip it.

attractions.name: If I Ran the Zoo
attractions.kidNote: Water-squirting play zone; aimed at younger kids.
attractions.tip: Quick cool-off.

attractions.name: Oh! The Stories You'll Hear!
attractions.kidNote: Seuss characters in a song-and-story show; aimed at younger kids.
attractions.tip: Hourly 11 AM–4:45 PM (late-Sept/early-Oct schedule).

attractions.name: Seuss Character Meet & Greet (Cat in the Hat, Thing 1 & 2, Grinch, Lorax)
attractions.kidNote: Quick photos.
attractions.tip: Check the app for times.

attractions.name: Stardust Racers
attractions.kidNote: A dueling 62-mph racer with big airtime; the twins will want to ride it again.
attractions.tip: Lockers plus metal detector. Waits often dip after dark, and the trains glow at night.

attractions.tip: Bring a change of clothes. Good while others ride Stardust.

attractions.name: Universal Celestial Goodnight
attractions.kidNote: Fountains, lights and fireworks paying tribute to Mario, Berk, Potter and the Monsters; a great finale.
attractions.tip: 8:00 PM at park close on Oct 15–17. Stake out the amphitheater around the Cosmos Fountain 20–30 minutes early.

attractions.name: Captain Cacao Meet & Greet
attractions.kidNote: Quirky space-explorer character; quick photo.
attractions.tip: Between Pizza Moon and The Oak & Star Tavern; added May 2026.

attractions.name: Mario Kart: Bowser's Challenge
attractions.kidNote: A dream for Mario fans: you throw shells in AR goggles and race Team Bowser, and the castle queue is epic.
attractions.tip: Go first at Early Park Admission or use Express. Single rider is also an option.

attractions.name: Mine-Cart Madness
attractions.kidNote: Carts appear to 'jump' track gaps; the kids will love it.
attractions.tip: Longest wait in the park. Use Express, single rider, or be first in line at Early Park Admission.

attractions.name: Yoshi's Adventure
attractions.kidNote: Slow egg hunt on a Yoshi; the twins may find it slow.

attractions.name: Bowser Jr. Challenge
attractions.kidNote: A boss battle you play by punching keys; big win for kids with Power-Up Bands.

attractions.name: Mario & Luigi Meet & Greet
attractions.kidNote: Must-do photo for Mario fans.
attractions.tip: Lines are shortest in the first hour or the late afternoon.

attractions.name: Princess Peach Meet & Greet

attractions.tip: Check the app for times.

attractions.name: Toad Meet & Greet

attractions.name: Donkey Kong Meet & Greet

attractions.tip: At the Donkey Kong Country treehouse; pair it with Mine-Cart Madness.

attractions.name: Monsters Unchained: The Frankenstein Experiment
attractions.kidNote: Genuinely frightening robot-arm ride (Dracula, Wolf Man, jump scares). Brave riders only.

guide.title: How your Express Pass works
guide.body: One Express ride per attraction per day, at all three parks, and it resets every morning. Scan the paper pass or the QR code in the Universal app at each ride's Express entrance. It does not work at Hagrid's, Pteranodon Flyers or Dragon Racer's Rally. Mark each Express ride as used in the Now tab and the suggestions will stop counting on it.

guide.title: Rider Switch
guide.body: When someone sits a ride out, tell the attendant at the entrance. The non-rider waits in the family room with the first group, then the second adult rides without lining up again. It works with Express.

guide.title: Height checks
guide.body: The youngest clears every ride except the Incredible Hulk Coaster (54") and Doctor Doom's Fearfall (52"). VelociCoaster is 51", so she clears it by half an inch with shoes on. Heights are measured at the entrance.

guide.title: Lockers and metal detectors
guide.body: Lockers are free for the posted wait plus ride time, then $3 per 30 minutes. Hulk, VelociCoaster and Stardust Racers have metal detectors: nothing in pockets at all, phones included. Gringotts, the Mummy, Men in Black, Forbidden Journey, Hagrid's, Monsters Unchained and Hiccup's also require a locker. Epic's lockers open with face scan, set up when you enter.

guide.title: Getting around
guide.body: Cabana Bay to CityWalk: 15–25 min walk or a shuttle every ~15 min. CityWalk to Islands: about 2 min; to Studios: about 7 min. Epic has its own shuttle from Cabana Bay (15–25 min). Hopping between Epic and Studios/Islands is a bus via CityWalk: budget 45–60 minutes.

guide.title: Early entry
guide.body: Cabana Bay guests get an hour early at Islands of Adventure (8am) and Epic Universe (9am Thursday, 8am Saturday). Not at Studios. Tickets are checked at entry, and guests are let in about 15 minutes before early entry starts.

guide.title: Studios closes at 5pm
guide.body: Halloween Horror Nights runs every night of the trip, so Universal Studios closes to day guests at 5pm. Horror Nights isn't recommended for kids under 13. Islands and Epic stay open until 8pm.

guide.title: Closed or changed
guide.body: Jurassic Park River Adventure is closed for refurbishment through Nov 19. Skull Island: Reign of Kong is running without its King Kong finale. Po Live!, the Horror Make-Up Show and Finnegan's are closed. Fast & Furious and Rip Ride Rockit are gone for good. The parade isn't expected to run.

guide.title: Mobile food ordering
guide.body: In the Universal app you can order food once you're inside the park, then tap "Prepare my food" when you're close. No upcharge. Availability changes, so check the app per restaurant.

guide.title: Prices to expect
guide.body: Power-Up Bands $45 each (link each one in the Universal app). Interactive wands $85 ($65 first-generation; engraving $30). The 10-year-olds pay adult prices at restaurants; kids' menus are for ages 9 and under.

guide.title: Single rider lines
guide.body: Good for anyone willing to ride alone: Gringotts, Men in Black, the Mummy, Transformers, Spider-Man, Hulk, Forbidden Journey, VelociCoaster, and most of Epic's big rides. Parents and young kids can't ride together from a single rider line.
